richiami.difetto: The product poses a risk of injuries because, due to the use of wrong material (swivel of the bearing pin), hair-line cracks in the weld seam of the bearing pin on the base-plate can occur in a number of the manual control devices. In the worst-case scenario, the bearing pin can come loose, leading to malfunction and even failure of the gas and brake actuation which could consequently lead to an accident.
richiami.omologazione_grezza: BHA01, BHA02, BHA03, BHA04 and BHA06.
richiami.rimedio: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): Other · Category of measure(s): Voluntary recall from consumers by the manufacturer. · Date of entry into force: Unknown
